name: of_isClosed
statement: ∀ (A : Set X), (∀ K, IsCompact K → IsClosed (K ↓∩ A)) → IsClosed A) : CompactlyCoherentSpace X where isCoherentWith

name: of_isOpen_forall_compactSpace
statement: ∀ (s : Set X), (∀ (K : Type u) [TopologicalSpace K], [CompactSpace K] → ∀ (f : K → X), Continuous f → IsOpen (f ⁻¹' s)) → IsOpen s) : CompactlyCoherentSpace X
